title: Patient Cancellation of Laboratory Test Orders and Consumer Order Refunds
content:
## When a patient may cancel

A patient may cancel their own Laboratory Test Orders order only before testing starts, that is from the status *received*, *information hold*, *accessioned* or *testing hold*. An order *in testing* or *resulted* cannot be cancelled, and its charges stand.

| Order status | Patient may cancel |
|---|---|
| Received | Yes |
| Information hold | Yes |
| Accessioned | Yes |
| Testing hold | Yes |
| In testing | No; charges stand |
| Resulted | No; charges stand |

## Credits on cancellation

On cancellation every uncredited charge line and add-on line of the order is credited with the reason *cancelled before testing*.

## Consumer-initiated orders

- On a consumer-initiated order, the oversight-fee line is not credited when the class keeps the oversight fee on cancellation.
- The prepaid amount, less any line kept, is refunded within the class's consumer refund period in business days.
- A consumer-initiated order not collected within the class's consumer order validity period, in calendar days from its order date, expires. It is then cancelled by the laboratory with the reason *requisition expired* and refunded the same way.

**Refund example (hypothetical amounts).** A consumer-initiated order prepaid at 60.95, made up of tests at 53.00 and an oversight fee of 7.95, is cancelled before collection in a class that keeps the oversight fee. The test lines are credited and the oversight-fee line is not. The refund is 60.95 less 7.95, that is 53.00.

## Retired clauses

> *No longer in force.* The former clause read: "Cancellation is the patient's own decision and is confirmed by the patient personally."

> *No longer in force.* The former clause read: "When the order was cancelled from accessioned or testing hold and the class's cancellation handling fee after accessioning is above 0.00, one charge line with the reason cancellation handling fee is posted at that amount; no handling fee applies to a cancellation before accessioning."

Both clauses are no longer in force: they have been superseded by the current basis for patient cancellations. The other sections of this policy remain in force.

superseded_clauses: Cancellation is the patient's own decision and is confirmed by the patient personally.

When the order was cancelled from accessioned or testing_hold and the class's cancellation_handling_fee_after_accession is above 0.00, one orders_test_charge_posted line with charge_reason cancellation_handling_fee is posted at that amount; no handling fee applies to a cancellation before accessioning.
